info.title: AgentXM Registry API
info.description: Public machine-client API for AgentXM auth, discovery, extension reads, publishing, and user-initiated lifecycle operations.

200.description: Registry service metadata including health status and documentation entry points.

get.description: Returns service metadata and documentation entrypoints when docs are enabled.

200.description: Response from the OAuth device authorization endpoint (RFC 8628). Keys are protocol-defined snake_case and exempt from the Registry's camelCase rule.

anyOf.description: Optional space-delimited scopes requested by the client, drawn from its registered allowlist.

schema.description: OAuth 2.0 device authorization request (RFC 8628). Parameter names are protocol-defined snake_case and exempt from the Registry's camelCase rule.

200.description: OAuth 2.0 token response: a session's access and refresh token pair, or a workload token exchanged for a CI identity token. Keys are protocol-defined snake_case (RFC 6749, RFC 8693) and exempt from the Registry's camelCase rule; `expires_at` is a Registry extension member kept in the message's casing.

400.description: InvalidRequestError | OAuth 2.0 token error response (RFC 6749 §5.2). Keys are protocol-defined snake_case and exempt from the Registry's camelCase rule. | DecodeErrorResponse

post.description: Issues a signed-in session's token pair for an authorization code, device code, or refresh token. With the RFC 8693 token-exchange grant, exchanges a GitHub Actions ID token that a trusted publisher trusts for a short-lived workload token with no refresh token; every refusal of the subject token is the same `invalid_grant`.
post.summary: Exchange OAuth grant for access token

anyOf.description: Identifier of the GitHub secret scanning key that signed the alert.
Base64 ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 signature over the exact request body.

post.description: GitHub secret scanning partner endpoint. The body is GitHub's JSON array of `{ token, type, url, source }` matches, signed over its exact bytes by a key GitHub publishes; an unsigned or badly signed alert is refused with 401 and nothing is revoked. Each live AgentXM token in a signed alert is revoked and its holder is told. The answer labels each match by the SHA-256 of its token, never the token.
post.summary: Revoke tokens found by GitHub secret scanning

DecodeErrorResponse.title: Decode Error Problem Details
DecodeErrorResponse.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details for a request that failed schema decoding; each `errors` entry points at one offending location.

ProblemDetails.title: Problem Details
ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details payload for AgentXM Registry errors.

retryable.description: Whether the client may retry the request.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Suggested delay in seconds before retrying.

requiredScope.description: The scope required to perform the operation, if applicable.

tokenScopes.description: The scopes present on the token used for the request.

requiredRole.description: The management role required, if applicable.

upgradeUrl.description: Where a person with billing authority can raise the limit: the plan page for the owner, or the seats page when seats are short.

PublishDetails.title: Publish Details
PublishDetails.description: Extended error details for publish-related and retryable error responses.

RegistryProblemCode.title: Registry Problem Code
RegistryProblemCode.description: Machine-readable problem code. `GET /v1/problems/{code}` describes each one.

token_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the reported token.

token_type.description: The token type GitHub reported for the match.

label.description: `true_positive` when the match was a live AgentXM token, now revoked; otherwise `false_positive`.

SecretScanningLabel.title: Secret Scanning Label
SecretScanningLabel.description: What one reported match turned out to be. Response format defined by GitHub's secret-scanning partner program, so its snake_case keys are exempt from the Registry's camelCase rule.

Version.title: Version
Version.description: A semver version like 1.0.0. Ranges are not allowed here.

PackMemberRegistrySource.description: A self-describing Registry locator for one Pack member.

VersionRange.title: Version Range
VersionRange.description: A semver version range like ^1.0.0, ~2.3.0, >=1.0.0 <3.0.0, or an exact version 1.2.3. Use "*" to always resolve to the latest available version.

ExtensionName.title: Extension Name
ExtensionName.description: The name of an extension — lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g. my-skill).

Handle.title: Handle
Handle.description: A unique username or organization name starting with @, like @my-org.

DeprecationReplacement.description: Authorization-safe current availability of a recorded replacement identity.

DeprecationMessage.description: Optional publisher notes for consumers of a deprecated extension.

ExtensionType.title: Extension Type
ExtensionType.description: What kind of extension this is: skill, mcp-server, subagent, rule, hook, knowledge, or pack.

VisibilityRevision.description: Opaque revision for conditional whole-Extension visibility mutation.

ExtensionVisibility.title: Extension Visibility
ExtensionVisibility.description: Whole-Extension Registry visibility applied to every published version.

PublishVisibility.title: Publish Visibility
PublishVisibility.description: Authoritative whole-Extension visibility and provenance resolved for a publication.

ResolutionMetadataCallerKey.description: Opaque caller correlation key. It grants no identity or authority.

ResolutionMetadataContinuation.description: Opaque token bound by the server to the request context and revision.

VersionEntry.title: Version Entry
VersionEntry.description: A single published version of an extension in the registry.

CompanionPackage_1.title: Companion Package
CompanionPackage_1.description: A companion package purl identity with an optional VERS compatibility range.

PackageIdentityPurl.title: Package Identity Purl
PackageIdentityPurl.description: A Package URL (purl) identity for a companion package. Companion package purls are identities, not pins: omit the purl @version segment and put compatibility constraints in versionRange.

Author_1.title: Author
Author_1.description: A person credited as a creator or maintainer of this extension.

Bugs_1.title: Bugs
Bugs_1.description: Where to report bugs against this extension. Accepts a URL string or an object with optional `url` and `email`.

anyOf.description: Version control system (e.g., `git`).
Subdirectory within the repository, for monorepo publishers.

Repository_1.title: Repository
Repository_1.description: Source repository for this extension. Accepts a URL string (or `host:owner/repo` shorthand) or an object with `type`, `url`, and optional `directory`.

requiredScope.description: The scope required to perform the requested operation.

tokenScopes.description: The scopes present on the token used for the request.

requiredRole.description: The management role required, if applicable.

requiredPermission.description: The staff permission required, if applicable.

admittedCredentials.description: The credential kinds the refused operation admits, if applicable.

settingsUrl.description: Where the person can perform a browser-only operation themselves.

AuthorizationDenyDetails.title: Authorization Deny Details
AuthorizationDenyDetails.description: Diagnostic details returned when a request is denied due to insufficient authorization.

ExtensionLinks.title: Extension Links
ExtensionLinks.description: Hyperlinks for an extension resource. `html` is the canonical web page URL.

ExtensionTypePlural.title: Extension Type (Plural)
ExtensionTypePlural.description: Plural form of the extension type used in URLs and identifiers (e.g. skills, hooks, packs).

YankAvailableVersionsBody.title: Yank Available Versions Body
YankAvailableVersionsBody.description: Atomically yanks the snapshot of all currently available versions.

YankVersionBody.title: Yank Version Body
YankVersionBody.description: Optional public context for yanking an extension version.

PublishIdentityMismatchEntry.title: Identity Mismatch Entry

PublishIdentity.title: Publish Identity
PublishIdentity.description: URL-path identity of the extension version under publish.

PublishLintFinding_1.title: Publish Lint Finding
PublishLintFinding_1.description: One lint finding produced against the publish subject.

PublishFindingLocation.title: Finding Location

PublishLintFinding.title: Publish Lint Finding
PublishLintFinding.description: One lint finding produced against the publish subject.

anyOf.description: Optional publisher notes, normalized by the Registry.

DeprecationReason.description: The publisher's structured reason for deprecating an extension.

ArchivalRevision.description: Opaque extension archival revision used for conditional writes.

CompanionPackage.title: Companion Package

TokenId.title: Token ID
TokenId.description: Identifies an access token or personal access token (PAT) issued to a user. Used to authenticate API requests to the registry.

expiresIn.description: How long the token lasts, in seconds. At least 1 hour; at most 90 days for a publish or admin token and 365 days for a read token.

CreateTokenRequest.title: Create Token Request

owners.description: Owner selectors for extension permissions. Use full handles or "all".

permission.description: What the token may do: read extensions, publish versions, or administer them.

CreateTokenPermissionsRequest.title: Create Token Permissions Request

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

hasMore.description: Whether another page follows. Always equals `cursor !== null`.

TokenListResponse.title: Token List Response
TokenListResponse.description: A page of the authenticated principal's access tokens, newest first.

anyOf.description: Human-readable name of the token, if assigned.

permissions.description: What this token may do. Null for an interactive session, which is its holder's whole authority.

AuthMeResponse.title: Auth Me Response
AuthMeResponse.description: Your user profile and credential details.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the credential used for this request.

anyOf.description: Human-readable name of the token, if assigned.

permissions.description: What this credential may do. Null when the authority is `account`.

authority.title: Credential Authority
authority.description: `account` when the credential is you signed in, bounded only by your permissions. `limited` when it is a credential you deliberately made narrower than yourself.

approvedAt.description: When the browser sign-in that approved this CLI session approved it. Null for any other kind of credential.

trustedPublisher.description: The trusted publisher this workload token acts through. Null for any other kind of credential.

AuthMeToken.title: Token Info
AuthMeToken.description: Details about the token you used to authenticate.

AuthMeTrustedPublisher.title: Trusted Publisher
AuthMeTrustedPublisher.description: The trusted publisher a workload token was exchanged through.

TrustedPublisherId.title: Trusted Publisher ID
TrustedPublisherId.description: Identifies a trusted publisher: a CI workflow identity a user allowed to exchange its OIDC token for a short-lived workload token.

extensions.description: Extension patterns this credential is limited to, or null if unrestricted.

ResourceRestrictions.title: Resource Restrictions
ResourceRestrictions.description: What this credential is allowed to access. Present only when the authority is `limited`.

anyOf.description: The user's email address, if available.

UserId.title: User ID
UserId.description: Identifies a registered user account. Assigned at sign-up and referenced by tokens, memberships, and audit trails.

refresh_token.description: OAuth 2.0 refresh token for obtaining a new token pair. Present for a signed-in session; absent for a workload token, which is exchanged again instead.

issued_token_type.description: Token exchange (RFC 8693): the type of the issued token. Present only for a token exchange.

expires_in.description: Access token lifetime remaining in seconds.

scope.description: Space-delimited scopes the workload token carries. Absent for a signed-in session, which carries its holder's whole authority.

TokenResponse.title: Token Response
TokenResponse.description: OAuth 2.0 token response: a session's access and refresh token pair, or a workload token exchanged for a CI identity token. Keys are protocol-defined snake_case (RFC 6749, RFC 8693) and exempt from the Registry's camelCase rule; `expires_at` is a Registry extension member kept in the message's casing.

device_code.description: Device verification code for the polling client.

user_code.description: Short code the user enters in the browser.

verification_uri.description: URI where the user should navigate to enter the user code.

verification_uri_complete.description: URI with the one-time code in the user_code query parameter, suitable for QR codes or direct links.

expires_in.description: Lifetime of the device code in seconds.

DeviceCodeResponse.title: Device Code Response
DeviceCodeResponse.description: Response from the OAuth device authorization endpoint (RFC 8628). Keys are protocol-defined snake_case and exempt from the Registry's camelCase rule.

anyOf.description: Path to the interactive API documentation, or null when docs are disabled.
Path to the OpenAPI specification, or null when docs are disabled.
